title: Zephyr: fragment generation
description: Implement SCHC fragment generation in Zephyr C. Acceptance: generates valid fragments, cross-validates with Python/Rust.
notes: Validated the current bounded Zephyr C fragmenter and added an isolated format-v2 canonical-vector host consumer in lichen/tests/schc_fragment_generation. Coverage: exact 3-fragment recovery corpus, all 64 literal fragments across All-0 W=0 to W=1, FCN 62..0/All-1 mapping, packet tile slices, CRC-32 RCS, borrowed-packet sender state, per-fragment undersized-output state/output atomicity, invalid init atomicity, and canonical 1,281 (8), 22,554 (126), and 22,555 rejection boundaries. No core change was needed: the accumulated fragmenter already satisfied acceptance and gz30's 179-byte constants were present, so gz30 was not an implementation blocker. Evidence: host AppleClang UBSan CMake/CTest 1/1; Python format-v2 integrity/production conformance 41/41; isolated Cargo fragmentation_vectors with std,raw-fragment-codec 2/2; local Zephyr 4.1 nRF52840 schc_generic full compile passed (139,513 B flash, 31,872 B RAM); cppcheck and git diff --check passed. Pinned v3.7 runtime remains gz30's independent validation gate, not required to establish this fragment-generation parity.
